suocera.aspetto: a grotesque but almost photographic tall old woman in her late seventies, upright and strong, not frail: a long narrow face, big round staring eyes, a very long thin nose, a small tight downturned mouth and deep lines on her forehead; in widow's black from head to toe: black headscarf tied under the chin, black cardigan, black skirt and thick black stockings

parti.occhi: Big, round, staring old eyes, the lids reddened from crying, but dry and clear: no fever, no sweat.

occhi_febbre.inquadratura: the eyes and the bridge of the nose, from the eyebrows to the cheekbones, the edge of the black headscarf
occhi_febbre.segni: Her big round eyes are glassy with fever, the lids red and swollen from crying, beads of sweat under the edge of the black headscarf.

parti.bocca: A small, tight old mouth with thin lips; her own teeth, yellowed by age but all there; nothing unusual.

collo.inquadratura: the side of her neck under the jaw, the black headscarf pulled aside
collo.segni: A wrinkled old neck with a thin black ribbon around it; no swelling, no lumps.

collo_febbre.inquadratura: the side of her neck under the jaw, the black headscarf pulled aside
collo_febbre.segni: A wrinkled old neck with a thin black ribbon around it; under the jaw a hard swollen lump the size of a walnut, red and shiny: a plague bubo just beginning.

parti.mani: Big, strong, bony old hands with swollen knuckles; dark earth under the fingernails, as if she had been kneeling at a grave; on the back of one finger a small, round, flat crust of dried red candle wax, dull and opaque like a crayon, dry and hard: no liquid, no shine, no wound, no blood.
